subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity allocation — CloudNova surge & proposed reshuffle
messages:
From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@cloudnova.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Q3 burst requirement — immediate capacity request

Aisha,

Quick note — we just closed a larger-than-expected contract amendment for a Q3 pilot (DN-78412). The pilot needs an immediate short-term burst of ~12x A100-equivalent slots for 6 weeks, starting ASAP. Our production launch date slipped forward and our internal estimate is that without the burst we’ll miss the pilot SLA.

I know reserved pools are tight; are there any options for a temporary reshuffle or emergency allocation? Procurement is on a separate thread but I wanted to reach you directly. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Jacobs
Director of ML Ops, CloudNova
ben.jacobs@cloudnova.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: CloudNova_MATP_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@cloudnova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q3 burst requirement — immediate capacity request

Ben — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the expansion. Short answer: we can probably accommodate a short burst, but it requires coordination across a few reserved pools and will have downstream SLAs/credits implications for other customers.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- I’ll loop in capacity planning (Marissa & Vivek) to check available headroom this week.
- We need Karthik to map compatible dedicated SKU substitutions (which customers could be temporarily scaled down with minimal risk).
- If we proceed, we’ll prepare a mutually agreed reshuffle memo and a temporary SLA addendum — that will include the credit calc if we reassign reserved slots.

Can you confirm: 1) exact GPU mtl (A100 40GB or equivalent), 2) ramp window (do you need all 12 immediately or phased over 3 days?), and 3) are you open to a hybrid (dedicated + burst from our shared capacity) model?

I’ll hold a 30m triage at 11:00 PT if that works — invite sent.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q3 burst requirement — immediate capacity request

Aisha / team — ran a fast pass on pool utilization. Summary:
- Region: us-west-2 reserved pools are at 92% committed this week.
- We have two near-term candidates for temporary reallocation: (1) RetailCo reserved cluster (low active traffic Tesing window Aug 2–9), (2) PilotLabs reserved slice (scheduled maintenance Aug 4–6). Together they could free ~8 A100-equivalent slots if we accept a modest risk window.
- Shared burst pool still has ~6 slots but those are shared and will increase latency for multi-tenant customers.

Constraints & risks:
- Reassigning reserved capacity requires 72h notice for RetailCo per contract; can be made shorter with an SLA amendment and sign-off from sales leadership.
- PilotLabs maintenance overlap may be an operational complexity but is doable if we delay their non-critical work by 24–48h.

I recommend: try hybrid approach — 6 reserved (via temporary reshuffle) + 6 shared burst. This minimizes wholesale customer impact but still meets CloudNova's requested 12-slot target. Details in attached proposed-reshuffle-memo.pdf.

Marissa Cole
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@cloudnova.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q3 burst requirement — immediate capacity request

Thanks — quick technical note for execution plan. If we do hybrid, we should: 
1) Pin CloudNova to a compatible quantized model build (to avoid kernel mismatches when moving between reserved to shared hosts).
2) Ensure KV cache warm-up script runs in the first two hours to avoid cold-start token costs.
3) Add automated routing rule so requests fall back to shared capacity only after dedicated pool is saturated (preserves latency).

Operational runbook (high level):
- T+0: Apply temporary allocation — update routing and model pin.
- T+1h: Run smoke tests and perf A/B.
- T+24h: Review telemetry and agree on continued reshuffle or unwind.

I can own the technical steps; need approvals on the contractual side for the 72h notice waiver and the credit terms.

— Karthik
Platform Lead, Serving Runtime
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@cloudnova.com>, CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity allocation — CloudNova surge & proposed reshuffle

Ben — summary and ask:
- We can deliver 12 A100-equivalent slots via a hybrid reshuffle (6 from reserved reassignments + 6 from shared burst) starting T+24 hours pending sign-off.
- Required approvals from CloudNova: acceptance of the temporary SLA addendum (one-page) and agreement to prorated credits if RetailCo or PilotLabs experience measurable SLA impact.
- Redwood ask: procurement approval to waive the 72h reassign notice for RetailCo for this one-time event (we’ll document in the addendum).

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll circulate the SLA addendum and the proposed-reshuffle-memo (attached).
2) Marissa + Karthik will run the execution playbook T+0 once we have signatures.
3) If you approve, procurement please acknowledge by EOD so we can start the reallocation tomorrow morning.

Ben — if you want a short call to finalize terms I’m available 5:00pm PT today. Otherwise, please reply with a quick ok + procurement confirmation.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: proposed-reshuffle-memo.pdf (memo), CloudNova_MATP_estimates.xlsx (customer spreadsheet)
